title: Tenure Extras on the Validity of Replacement Free Night Awards
content:
A member's tenure in Ashbury Rewards adds a tenure extra to the validity of a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed. The tenure extra is added to the replacement validity months before the expiry date is worked out.

The tenure extra counts whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the reissue date: at least the upper tenure months earn the upper tenure extra, at least the lower tenure months the lower tenure extra, and fewer nothing.

| Whole calendar months from enrolment date to reissue date | Tenure extra |
|---|---|
| At least 180 (upper tenure months) | 2 months (upper tenure extra) |
| At least 120 but fewer than 180 (lower tenure months) | 1 month (lower tenure extra) |
| Fewer than 120 | No tenure extra |

The enrolment date is the one on the Ashbury Rewards membership record; the reissue date is the date the replacement is deposited. A hypothetical member enrolled 179 whole months before the reissue receives 1 month; at 180 whole months, 2 months; at 119, none.
